items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: At the same time I was at the Casino, Billy Daniels came through and he was staying at the Carlton where all the tourists stayed

ctx.x: '52 or '53, but anyway that was the same band that we used at the Palm Beach Casino. At the same time I was at the Casino, Billy Daniels came through and he was staying at the Carlton where all the tourists stayed, Palm Beach Carlton. Also Wally Simpson came there, as well as the big gambling.
How was it in North Africa?
